items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: "I went upstairs and I said, 'Honey, what has happened?' She said, 'I don't know.'"

ctx.x: On 146th and Amsterdam. But the neighbor-

hood is -- had really gone down, but when I moved in there, like in 1940, it was still nice, well kept, nice people, and this was before the war. Then after the war, people -- I came off the road one day and I saw people just all out on the streets and standing in the front of the apartment, so I went upstairs and I said, "Honey, what has happened?" She said, "I don't know. Looked like a plane just come over and dropped them all right here on 146th Street and Amsterdam Avenue." But before then, man, it was well…
You brought up your kids really on the Island.
